tip: Follow the lifeguard flags - currents can be strong.

title: Glad we went
body: Palolem Beach is a lovely beach, with a few small issues. The shacks nearby serve good, fresh food. It was the monsoon, so expect rain and slippery ground. There were only a few other visitors. About 150 minutes was the right amount of time. Entry is free. Recommended.
tip: Stay for the sunset.

title: Simply beautiful
body: Marari Beach was the highlight of our day. The shacks nearby serve good, fresh food. Also, the sand is clean and the sunset is beautiful. It got quite crowded as the morning went on. We ended up staying around 100 minutes - longer than planned. Entry is free. Don't miss it if you are in the area.

title: Worth every minute
body: Lotus Mahal was the highlight of our day. Walking through it feels like stepping back in time. There were only a few other visitors. We spent about 35 minutes, which felt a little rushed. Entry is free. Highly recommended.

title: Mixed experience
body: Mixed feelings about Kumari Amman Temple. The carvings and the old architecture are stunning, but it was hard to get information about the history. It was quiet, almost empty when we arrived. About 45 minutes was the right amount of time. Entry is free. Fine if you are nearby, but don't plan a day around it.
tip: Photography is not allowed inside the sanctum.

title: Needs better upkeep
body: Not the best temple we have seen. It was hard to get information about the history. On top of that, the area around the temple was crowded and noisy. It was packed, so expect to share the view. We ended up staying around 70 minutes - longer than planned. Entry is free. Needs a lot of improvement.

title: Very good visit
body: Mallikarjuna Jyotirlinga Temple is a lovely temple, with a few small issues. The atmosphere during the morning puja was very peaceful. Hardly anyone else was there. About 150 minutes was the right amount of time. Entry is free. Recommended.

title: The best part of the trip
body: Bear Shola Falls is every bit as good as people say. The sound of the water and the forest around it make it very calming. Also, the short walk down through the greenery is half the fun. We came during the monsoon, so the water was at its fullest. A fair number of people, nothing too bad. About 45 minutes was the right amount of time. Entry is free. Highly recommended.
tip: Wear shoes with grip - the steps get slippery.

title: Very good visit

It got quite crowded as the morning went on. We ended up staying around 70 minutes - longer than planned. The ₹10 ticket is good value. Recommended.
tip: Check the weather - on a misty day you will see very little.

title: Glad we went
